title: 茶水间英文 - 10月15日 | 通胀爆表、八州起诉、蜘蛛甜甜圈
description:
Alex and Jordan unpack a hotter-than-expected September inflation report that has Wall Street betting on another Fed rate hike, a coordinated lawsuit by eight states accusing OpenAI of marketing ChatGPT as safe for kids, and Dunkin's Halloween comeback of its viral Spider Donut. Each story comes with a ready-to-steal small-talk line, plus today's random question: what brand-new emoji would sum up your life right now?

今天 Alex 和 Jordan 聊了三个新鲜话题：九月通胀数据高于预期，华尔街开始押注美联储可能再次加息；美国八个州联合起诉 OpenAI，指控 ChatGPT 对孩子不够安全；Dunkin 的网红蜘蛛甜甜圈万圣节回归，还带来一款紫色新饮品。每个话题都附一句拿来即用的英文开场白，最后还有一道快问：如果键盘上新增一个能概括你现状的表情符号，会是什么样？

Words to steal 生词本:
- hotter-than-expected — 高于预期的；爆表的
- rate hike — 加息
- scale back — 缩减；降低
- allege — 指控；声称（尚未证实）
- public listing — 公开上市
- tease — 在社交媒体上吊胃口、预告
- mascot — 吉祥物
